items.item_text: Salesforce certification is required.
Epic certification is preferred at hire and will be required within 6 months of hire
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is required.
Master’s Degree is preferred
At least 5 years experience building and designing CRM software solutions from conception to delivery is required.
Previous work experience in healthcare IT or health related organization is preferred
At least 3 years experience building applications on Salesforce platforms is required.
Experience with Epic CRM tools is preferred
Previous management experience and effective leadership skills are required.
Experience leading a mix of both local and remote team members is preferred
At least 3 years managing technology programs and/or teams is required.
Direct experience designing and maintaining software integrations that connect enterprise and cloud-based platforms with Salesforce
Project management experience to manage project plan, lead meetings, prioritize, resolve conflicts

Take a leading role in shaping the future of connected health technology at UCLA Health. As the Salesforce and CRM Application Manager, you will lead the people, platforms, and technical strategy behind enterprise CRM solutions that support complex clinical and business operations across the health system.

Reporting to the Director of Connected Health, you will oversee the development, integration, optimization, and support of UCLA Health’s Salesforce platform and integrated CRM workflows, including connections with Epic. You will partner with clinical leaders, operational teams, technology experts, governance groups, Salesforce, and Epic to transform business needs into secure, scalable, and sustainable solutions.
In this highly visible role, you will:
Lead and develop a team of technical professionals supporting Salesforce and enterprise CRM applications.
Drive application strategy, architecture, development, integration, implementation, and optimization.
Provide senior-level technical direction for complex applications, databases, interfaces, and integrations.
Partner across UCLA Health to design technology solutions that improve clinical and business workflows.
Guide major enhancements and evaluate new solutions based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, security, and long-term sustainability.
Strengthen application performance, reliability, system integrity, and operational support.
Help define the long-term technology roadmap for UCLA Health’s Salesforce and CRM environment.

This role is ideal for a technology leader who can move seamlessly between strategy, technical architecture, team leadership, and stakeholder partnership while helping advance UCLA Health’s digital capabilities.

This flexible hybrid role allows for a blend of remote and on-site work, requiring presence on-site about 3 days per quarter. In rare urgent escalation situations, the SLA to get onsite is within 12 hours of notice or as needed based on operational requirements. Please note, travel to the “home office” location is not reimbursed. Each employee will complete a FlexWork Agreement with their manager to outline expectations and ensure mutual understanding. These arrangements are periodically reviewed and may be adjusted or terminated as necessary.
Salary offers are based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and internal equity. The University anticipates offering a salary between the minimum and midpoint of this range.

Ability to establish and maintain a spirit of cooperation and respect, flourish in an unstructured environment, and always engage in professional and ethical conduct

High functioning team skills, including active listening, rapport building, effective written & verbal communication, receiving and delegating work assignments

Ability to identify, document, resolve and/or escalate issues and maintain a complete issues log

Ability to manage multiple and competing tasks
